title: Rappler Recap: Myanmar, South China Sea among issues as 49th ASEAN Summit opens
summary: Rappler’s Lance Spencer Yu and Jelo Mantaring walk you through events and developments on the opening day of the summit
byline: Rappler.com, Lance Spencer Yu, Jelo Ritzhie Mantaring

blocks.text: Rappler’s Lance Spencer Yu and Jelo Mantaring walk you through events and developments on the opening day of the summit

MANILA, Philippines – As the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit kicked off on Sunday, November 15, leaders from the region and beyond arrived in Manila to tackle a variety of issues, from the Myanmar crisis and the South China Sea to transboundary haze.
Rappler’s Lance Spencer Yu and Jelo Mantaring walk you through events and developments on the opening day of the summit. – Rappler.com
